statuses.reason: The operation names no object in its path or body, so there is nothing that can be missing. Ids in its query (tag_id, event_id, payment_settings_id, debt_category_id) are filters: paths./debts.get documents for debt_category_id that another organisation's id matches nothing, so an unknown id narrows the list to nothing rather than answering 404.

properties.reason: The debt's own transaction holds the amount owed (components.requestBodies.UpdateDebt: its amount is the debt amount). No documented input sets a payment system or a bank account on it: UpdateDebt.transaction has only amount, transaction_id and payment_method, and CreateDebt.bank_account_id is the bank account the payment was made to, which the separate payment record carries. Card payments cannot be taken through the API at all.
